name: crew
description: The crew's workflow, owned by no role: in a GitHub repository with a crew board it points every session at the crew-workflow skill (each step through its crew command, no asking from In Definition to In approval, stops at In approval, starts QA when the Captain moves a card to QA, stops at Ready for Merge); in one without, the session offers to create the board. Also creates crew boards. Use when asked to do, work or ship a ticket, pick up the next issue, or create a project board.
